A '''pasty-skinned male Twi'lek''' was part of the [[Ryloth Senatorial Delegation]] led by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] in the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellorship]].<ref name="TPMIG" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was still serving under Taa when the remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockaded]] by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], an event that led to the removal of Valorum and his [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|being replaced]] by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of Naboo.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> A [[Color/Legends|white]]-skinned Twi'lek with red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], he [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] a satiny brown [[Robe/Legends|robe]] and a dark, patterned vest with puffed sleeves when he sat at the Senate.<ref name="TPMIG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|My part in the scene was a cut away from Queen Amidala when she proposed the vote of no confidence in Chancellor Valorum. It was originally my character that called for the vote with me screaming "Vote Now!" at the rest of the Senate.|Alan Ruscoe|<ref name="Afi" />}}
A pasty-skinned senatorial aide played by [[Alan Ruscoe]] was going to appear in Orn Free Taa's pod during the Senate scene of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. That scene, however, was left on the cutting room's floor.<ref name="dbBib">{{DB|character|bibfortuna|Fortuna, Bib}}</ref> Ruscoe's part was a cut away from [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she proposed the vote of no confidence in Chancellor Valorum, with his character screaming "Vote Now!" at the rest of the assembly. According to the actor, the character he portrayed was originally intended to be [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], the Twi'lek [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] from the [[1983]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Afi">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2011/10/star-wars-aficionado-interview-alan.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=Interview: Alan Ruscoe}}</ref>

Ruscoe's claim is backed up by an early piece of concept art drawn by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] in [[1997]], which showed a senator named Bib Fortuna alongside Orn Free Taa and [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]]. However, the official [[Databank (original)|Databank]] on [[StarWars.com]] offered a different explanation. According to the Databank, the character played by Ruscoe was only ''nicknamed'' "Bib Fortuna" by the production because of his resemblance with the majordomo from ''Return of the Jedi'', but was never meant to be the same character.<ref name="dbBib" /> Two pictures of Ruscoe as a Twi'lek appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'', an interactive CD-ROM that was released the same year as the movie, in which he was referred to as "a Twi'lek senator."<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:Wood_Fortuna_closeup.png|thumb|left|Matthew Wood as Bib Fortuna]]
While the pallid Twi'lek aide did not appear on screen, the real Fortuna did make a cameo appearance elsewhere in ''The Phantom Menace'', portayed by Supervising Sound Editor [[Matthew Wood]] with a costume and make-up different from those worn by Ruscoe.<ref name="TPM" /> While the [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 6|sixth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection]]'' correctly identified Wood as the actor who portrayed Fortuna in ''The Phantom Menace'', it also used a picture of the pasty-skinned aide.<ref name="OS&V">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 6|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 6]]</ref> One of the cards featuring Fortuna in the digital card game ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' also made the same mistake.<ref name="Four-star">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''&mdash;Bib Fortuna (Majordomo) (★★★★)</ref>

The "Twi'lek" entry of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]], the former official ''Star Wars'' information database, also used a picture of Alan Ruscoe in Twi'lek costume composited with pictures of [[Ayy Vida/Legends|Ayy Vida]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]].<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|groups|twileks|Twi'leks}}</ref>
